name: Soyuz TMA-14M
about: Soyuz TMA-14M (2014-057A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMM), launched 2014 Sep 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2014 Sep 25), held fixed
docked to S36086; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
